channel.title: Osaurus (Intel)
channel.description: Updates for Osaurus (Intel) — the cloud-powered Intel Mac fork.

item.description:
## Osaurus (Intel) 1.0.7
- 🧩 The chat model picker is now fully provider-driven — no hardcoded models. Every model comes from the providers you configure in Settings → Providers (a local llama.cpp/Ollama server, DeepSeek, OpenAI, any OpenAI-compatible endpoint). Add a provider, its models appear; remove it, they're gone. - 🌳 This is the distributable shape: run Osaurus on an Intel Mac with only a local model, only a cloud key, or both side by side.

## Osaurus (Intel) 1.0.6
- 🌳 Configured providers now actually show their models. The app probes each enabled provider's /models endpoint (at launch, when you open the Providers tab, and after add/edit) and caches the result — so a local llama.cpp server (Bonsai), Ollama, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint shows a real model count AND appears in the chat model picker. Fixes "0 models available" and the picker only ever listing DeepSeek. - 🚇 Selecting one of those models routes the request to that provider (its own URL + auth — no-auth local servers included), not DeepSeek. - 🔄 Auto-updater retargeted to the renamed repo (osaurus-intel).

## Osaurus (Intel) 1.0.5
- 🌳 Local + custom models now work end-to-end. The chat model picker lists every model from your configured providers (Settings → Providers) — a local llama.cpp server (e.g. Bonsai), Ollama, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint — not just the built-in DeepSeek tiers. - 🚇 Chat requests now route to the provider that owns the selected model (its own URL + auth, including no-auth local servers), instead of always going to DeepSeek. - 🔄 Newly added or edited providers appear in the picker immediately — no relaunch.

## Osaurus (Intel) 1.0.4
- 🔐 Tool-permission prompt is now the real Osaurus card (icon, description, formatted arguments, Allow / Deny / Always Allow, esc/return shortcuts) instead of a plain system dialog. - 🎹 Fixed: setting a new global hotkey + Save now actually replaces the old one (previously the re-registration was silently skipped on Intel).

## Osaurus (Intel) 1.0.3
- 🎹 Global hotkey now summons the chat window from ANY app (activates Osaurus + moves the window to the active Space) — fixes the "nothing happens from another app / gets stuck" case. Press again while it's frontmost to hide it. - 🔐 Richer tool-approval dialog: shows the tool description + formatted arguments, with Allow / Deny / Always Allow (Always Allow sets the tool to Auto so it won't ask again).

## Osaurus (Intel) 1.0.2
Bug-fix release.
- 📊 Context-budget popover now shows the full breakdown (System Prompt + Tools + Conversation) on restored sessions, not just typing tokens. - 🏷️ Model-generated chat titles fixed (completeChat now honors max_tokens + disables reasoning). - 🔐 Tool permissions persist across restart AND are enforced: Deny blocks a tool, Ask shows a confirmation before running. - 🎹 Added diagnostics to the global hotkey (still being chased — run from Terminal to see why it isn't firing).

## Osaurus (Intel) 1.0.1
First published build — cloud-powered Osaurus running natively on Intel Macs (x86_64).
- Cloud chat (DeepSeek / OpenAI-compatible) with live reasoning + tool-call streaming - Native x86_64 plugins, folder context, schedules, watchers, themes, agents, MCP tools - Global hotkey, identity sync, persisted settings, smart chat titles - Auto-updates now flow from this repo
